categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Labeled 'RPC/REST/ZMQ' and modifies the decodepsbt RPC response structure to include a new control_block_warnings diagnostic field.
categories.rationale: Adds helpful diagnostic warnings to decodepsbt for malformed taproot leaf control blocks. While InferTaprootTree silently skipped unusable candidates, reporting them resolves a debugging gap for signers and developers without impacting compatibility or security.
